These are an independent carrier for POL-NS-01(b) and (c): arrival established at 13:06:00; free wait served because wait_timer_expired (13:10:05) precedes termination (13:14:10) by 245 s. No admissible fix places the driver outside the radius or moving >=15 km/h during the window -> NS-12 holds.
3. POL-NS-01: (a) arrived event present. (b) satisfied via NS-12 at 13:06:00 (export also corroborates: nearest fix 13:06:20, 20 s later, 5.6 m). (c) free_wait_sec in force 240 (platform_policy); dwell arrival->cancel 490 s (from first in-radius export fix 13:06:20: 470 s) >= 240; no_show_threshold_sec 360 is longer, so cancellation must fall at/after 13:12:00 (or 13:12:20 if measured from 13:06:20) - cancelled 13:14:10, satisfied. (d) no boarding event; CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER with RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell elapsed. All four limbs hold.
4. POL-NS-03 n/a (driver inside radius, not 120-400 m). doubts: (1) Amount: the driver asks for 6.00 (the full net fee). POL-NS-07 pays 80% of the net fee (4.80), even though platform_policy says the 6.00 net already goes to the driver; a reader treating the claim as a refund of the reversed fee to the filing party could argue FULL_REFUND 6.00, but NS-01 notes and NS-07 say the emitted ruling on a verified no-show is DRIVER_COMPENSATION at 80%. (2) Whether the rider's statement plus support's reversal on the GPS export should be treated as a NS-09(b) conflict -> ESCALATE; I do not, because a party statement is not an admissible artifact and the export, though sparse, agrees with the platform events (5.6-17.8 m, 0 km/h).
